title: Horse armor craft
description: Makes all horse armor craftable in Minecraft
body:
**It's a simple mod that makes all horse armors craftable in Minecraft**

**Features:**
- Makes all horse armor types craftable
- Uses the same simple craft as leather horse armor, but with other materials
- Doesn't require any dependecies

**Why download this?**
- This mod is great for vanilla lovers
- Adds a simple craft, that you would always remember
